# OwnPay - Open-Source, Self-Hosted Payment Gateway

> OwnPay is an open-source, self-hosted payment gateway platform built on PHP 8.3. It supports 100+ payment gateways, multi-brand tenancy, white-label checkout, double-entry ledger, and plugin extensibility. Create by [Fattain Naime](https://iamnaime.info.bd)

## Key Technical Details

- PHP 8.3, MySQL 8, Redis, Twig 3, custom framework
- Money handled via bcmath (all amounts as strings)
- PII encrypted with AES-256-GCM
- Webhook signatures: HMAC-SHA256
- API auth: Bearer token with scopes (read, write, admin)
- Multi-tenant: isolated brands with own gateways, domains, ledger
- Plugins: gateway, addon, theme, integration types
- Companion App: Android SMS auto-verification
- License: AGPL-3.0, zero transaction fees
- API base URL: `https://your-domain.com/api/v1`
